characters.look: a young dark-haired man in a dark red leather coat with a crimson hood holding a short wand
characters.setting: a walled sandstone training courtyard in an autumn old town with three wooden training dummies on round stands, stacked wooden crates and square sandstone pillars
characters.lighting: Bright clear afternoon sunlight casts soft shadows across the paving
characters.props: The walls become warm sandstone with orange ivy and fallen autumn leaves, the ground is sandstone paving, the three grey dummies become wooden training dummies with straw-stuffed sacking bodies on round wooden stands, the boxes become wooden crates and the tall blocks become sandstone pillars.

melee_attack.name: Flame Fist
melee_attack.text: draws back his flame-wrapped right fist and drives a burning punch into {target} in a shower of sparks

phases.windup: steps in and draws his right fist back, flames curling up around his knuckles
phases.impact: his burning fist crashes into {target} in a shower of sparks and embers
phases.recover: pulls his fist back and settles into a ready stance

ranged_attack.name: Fireball
ranged_attack.text: raises his wand to shoulder height at {target}, a flame gathering at its tip, and hurls a fireball that bursts into flames on it
ranged_attack.again: raises his wand again and hurls another fireball at {target}

phases.windup: plants his feet and raises his wand to shoulder height toward {target}, a flame flickering to life at its tip
phases.release: flicks the wand forward and a roaring fireball bursts from its tip
phases.travel: the fireball streaks across the courtyard trailing sparks and smoke
phases.impact: it explodes in a ball of orange flame against {target}

dash.name: Ember Dash
dash.text: dashes forward low in a streak of embers that scorch the ground

moves.walk_to: walks toward {target} with an easy stride, his free arm swinging and red coat flapping
moves.back: backs away with light, careful steps, wand held low
moves.strafe_left: sidesteps left in a loose, ready crouch
moves.turn_to: pivots on his heel to face {target}
moves.idle: stands loose and ready, the wand low in his right hand

characters.look: a silver-haired woman in a white and blue fur-trimmed robe with a long blue cape holding an ice-crystal staff
characters.setting: a snow-covered walled stone training courtyard in a northern winter town with three wooden training dummies on round stands, frosted crates and square stone pillars hung with icicles
characters.lighting: Cold pale winter daylight lights the snow
characters.props: The walls become grey stone with snow on top and icicles, the ground is snow-dusted flagstones, the three grey dummies become wooden training dummies with frosted sacking bodies on round wooden stands, the boxes become frosted wooden crates and the tall blocks become stone pillars hung with icicles.

melee_attack.name: Frost Staff
melee_attack.text: pulls her staff back and thrusts its crystal head into {target} in a burst of frost
melee_attack.again: jabs her frosted staff into {target} again

phases.windup: steps in and pulls her staff back with both hands, its crystal glowing cold blue
phases.impact: the crystal head of her staff cracks into {target} in a burst of frost and ice
phases.recover: draws the staff back to her side, her cape settling

ranged_attack.name: Ice Shard
ranged_attack.text: levels her ice-crystal staff at {target} at shoulder height, frost swirling around its head, and fires an ice shard that shatters into frost on it
ranged_attack.again: levels her staff again and fires another ice shard at {target}

phases.windup: plants her feet and levels her ice-crystal staff at {target} at shoulder height, frost swirling around its crystal head
phases.release: snaps the staff forward and a jagged ice shard launches from its glowing crystal
phases.travel: the shard spins across the courtyard leaving a trail of glittering frost in the air
phases.impact: it shatters against {target} in a burst of ice crystals that frost its surface

dash.name: Frost Glide
dash.text: glides forward low on a trail of frost, her cape streaming behind her

moves.walk_to: walks toward {target} with a graceful stride through the snow, her blue cape swaying
moves.back: steps back through the snow, staff held across her body
moves.strafe_left: sidesteps left with light steps, her cape trailing
moves.turn_to: turns smoothly to face {target}, her cape swinging
moves.idle: stands poised, staff upright at her side, her cape stirring in the wind

characters.look: a soldier in olive combat fatigues, a plate carrier vest and a helmet carrying an assault rifle
characters.setting: a walled concrete military training yard with three padded target dummies on round stands, stacked supply crates and square concrete pillars
characters.lighting: Flat grey overcast daylight lights the yard
characters.props: The walls become weathered concrete blast walls, the ground is cracked concrete with faded markings and puddles, the three grey dummies become padded olive target dummies on round steel stands, the boxes become stacked military supply crates and the tall blocks become concrete pillars.

melee_attack.name: Rifle Butt
melee_attack.text: draws his rifle back and drives the stock into {target} with a heavy thud
melee_attack.again: slams the rifle stock into {target} again

phases.windup: steps in and draws his rifle back, gripping it with both hands
phases.impact: the rifle stock slams into {target} with a heavy thud
phases.recover: brings the rifle back across his chest

ranged_attack.name: Burst Fire
ranged_attack.text: shoulders his assault rifle and aims at {target}, firing a short burst with bright muzzle flashes that kicks dust off it
ranged_attack.again: shoulders his rifle again and fires another burst into {target}

phases.windup: plants his feet and brings his assault rifle up to his shoulder, aiming down the sights at {target}
phases.release: squeezes the trigger and the rifle kicks against his shoulder with bright muzzle flashes
phases.travel: a short burst of tracer rounds streaks across the yard
phases.impact: the rounds punch into {target}, kicking up puffs of dust and torn padding

dash.name: Combat Sprint
dash.text: breaks into a low combat sprint, boots kicking up dust

moves.walk_to: advances toward {target} in a steady tactical walk, rifle held low across his chest
moves.back: backs away in a crouched tactical step, rifle up
moves.strafe_left: side-steps left in a low crouch, rifle trained ahead
moves.turn_to: swings around to face {target}, rifle following his eyes
moves.idle: stands alert, rifle held low across his chest, scanning the yard

characters.look: a woman with a black ponytail in a long green coat with a leather waist corset
characters.setting: a walled training courtyard of an old East Asian martial arts school with whitewashed walls, tiled roof edges and red lanterns, three wooden training dummies on round stands, wooden crates and square red pillars
characters.lighting: Soft hazy morning daylight fills the misty courtyard
characters.props: The walls become whitewashed walls with grey tiled roof edges and red paper lanterns, the ground is grey stone paving, the three grey dummies become wooden wing-chun training dummies on round wooden stands, the boxes become wooden crates and the tall blocks become red lacquered pillars.

melee_attack.name: Palm Strike
melee_attack.text: draws her right hand back to her hip and shoots a fast open-palm strike into {target}
melee_attack.again: lands another fast palm strike on {target}

phases.windup: steps in low and draws her right hand back to her hip, palm open
phases.impact: her open palm snaps into {target} with a sharp crack, her coat flaring with the blow
phases.recover: pulls her hand back into a guarded stance

ranged_attack.name: Steel Darts
ranged_attack.text: flicks her right hand back and snaps her arm straight out at {target}, throwing a fan of glinting silver darts that streak in bright lines into it
ranged_attack.again: snaps her arm out again, throwing more glinting darts into {target}

phases.windup: sets her feet and draws her right hand back past her shoulder, three steel darts glowing white-hot between her fingers
phases.release: snaps her arm straight out toward {target} and the darts leave her hand as three blazing white streaks of light
phases.travel: the three glowing darts shoot across the courtyard like tiny comets, leaving long bright white trails in the air
phases.impact: they slam into {target} in three bright bursts of white sparks and flying splinters

dash.name: Shadow Step
dash.text: darts forward in a blur, her green coat flaring and ponytail whipping behind her

moves.walk_to: walks toward {target} with light, springy steps, her green coat swishing and ponytail swaying
moves.back: slides back in a balanced stance, hands raised
moves.strafe_left: circles left on the balls of her feet, guard up
moves.turn_to: turns sharply to face {target}, settling into a fighting stance
moves.idle: stands in a relaxed ready stance, hands loose at her sides

characters.look: a pale man with slicked black hair in a long high-collared crimson coat
characters.setting: a walled cobblestone courtyard of a gothic manor with three wooden training dummies on round stands, old wooden crates and square stone pillars
characters.lighting: Bright silvery overcast daylight lights the stones
characters.props: The walls become dark gothic stone with pointed arches and wrought iron, the ground is grey cobblestones, the three grey dummies become wooden training dummies with dark sacking bodies on round wooden stands, the boxes become old wooden crates and the tall blocks become carved stone pillars.

melee_attack.name: Blood Claw
melee_attack.text: draws back his clawed right hand and rakes {target} in a slash trailing crimson blood mist

phases.windup: steps in and draws his clawed right hand back, crimson mist gathering around his fingers
phases.impact: his claws rake across {target}, leaving glowing red gashes and a trail of blood mist
phases.recover: lowers his hand, his coat settling around him

ranged_attack.name: Blood Bolt
ranged_attack.text: extends his right hand at {target}, crimson mist swirling around his fingers, and casts a glowing blood bolt that bursts in a red spray on it
ranged_attack.again: extends his hand again and casts another blood bolt at {target}

phases.windup: raises his right hand toward {target} at shoulder height, fingers spread as crimson mist coils around them
phases.release: clenches his hand and a glowing crimson blood bolt tears free from his palm
phases.travel: the bolt streaks across the courtyard leaving a trail of red mist
phases.impact: it bursts against {target} in a spray of crimson droplets

dash.name: Mist Step
dash.text: dissolves into crimson mist that rushes forward and re-forms into his body

moves.walk_to: walks toward {target} with a slow, elegant stride, his long crimson coat sweeping behind him
moves.back: drifts back with smooth, unhurried steps
moves.strafe_left: slides to the left with a smooth, predatory step
moves.turn_to: turns to face {target} with a cold, deliberate motion
moves.idle: stands perfectly upright, hands at his sides, his coat stirring slightly

characters.look: a bearded man with braided hair in dark armour and a fur-collared blue cloak carrying a heavy war hammer
characters.setting: a walled flagstone training yard in a Norse village with round shields hung on the walls, three straw training dummies on round stands, wooden crates and square timber-and-stone pillars
characters.lighting: Bright sunlight after rain shines under a blue sky with white clouds
characters.props: The walls become stone-and-timber walls with round painted shields hung on them, the ground is wet flagstones, the three grey dummies become straw-wrapped training dummies on round wooden stands, the boxes become wooden crates and the tall blocks become carved timber-and-stone pillars.

melee_attack.name: Thunder Hammer
melee_attack.text: draws his war hammer back and swings it into {target} with a crack of blue lightning
melee_attack.again: swings his crackling hammer into {target} again

phases.windup: steps in and draws his war hammer back with both hands, lightning crackling along it
phases.impact: the crackling hammer smashes into {target} with a thunderclap of blue lightning
phases.recover: swings the hammer back to his side, sparks fading

ranged_attack.name: Lightning Call
ranged_attack.text: thrusts his war hammer at {target} at shoulder height, sparks crackling along its head, and a jagged lightning bolt strikes down from the sky onto it
ranged_attack.again: points his hammer again and calls another lightning bolt down on {target}

phases.windup: plants his feet and thrusts his war hammer forward toward {target} at shoulder height, blue sparks crackling along its head
phases.release: raises the hammer as it flashes white, and the sky above {target} darkens with a rumble
phases.travel: a jagged lightning bolt splits the air and strikes straight down
phases.impact: it crashes onto {target} in a blinding white flash and a burst of crackling sparks

dash.name: Storm Charge
dash.text: charges forward with heavy pounding steps, blue lightning crackling around him

moves.walk_to: strides toward {target} with heavy, powerful steps, his fur-collared cloak swaying and hammer at his side
moves.back: steps back heavily, hammer held ready
moves.strafe_left: shifts left with heavy sideways steps, hammer ready
moves.turn_to: turns his broad shoulders to face {target}
moves.idle: stands broad and steady, the war hammer hanging from his right hand

characters.look: a bearded red-haired man in a green leafy cloak holding a spiral wooden staff
characters.setting: a walled stone-paved training courtyard in a forest village with ivy-covered walls, three wooden training dummies on round stands, wooden crates and moss-covered square stone pillars
characters.lighting: Warm late-afternoon sunlight lights the courtyard
characters.props: The walls become old stone walls covered in ivy, the ground is mossy stone paving, the three grey dummies become wooden training dummies with woven-vine bodies on round wooden stands, the boxes become wooden crates and the tall blocks become moss-covered stone pillars.

melee_attack.name: Thorn Staff
melee_attack.text: pulls his spiral staff back and thrusts its thorn-wrapped head into {target} in a spray of leaves
melee_attack.again: jabs his thorny staff into {target} again

phases.windup: steps in and pulls his spiral staff back, thorny vines curling around its head
phases.impact: the thorn-wrapped head of his staff jabs into {target} in a spray of leaves
phases.recover: brings the staff back upright beside him

ranged_attack.name: Thorn Bolt
ranged_attack.text: points his spiral staff at {target} at shoulder height, green light swirling at its tip, and launches a glowing thorn bolt that bursts into leaves on it
ranged_attack.again: points his staff again and launches another glowing thorn bolt at {target}

phases.windup: plants his feet and points his spiral staff at {target} at shoulder height, green light and leaves swirling around its tip
phases.release: thrusts the staff forward as its tip flares bright green and a bolt of thorns shoots out
phases.travel: the glowing thorn bolt spins across the courtyard shedding green leaves
phases.impact: it bursts against {target} in a spray of thorns, splinters and leaves

dash.name: Leaf Dash
dash.text: dashes forward in a swirl of green leaves

moves.walk_to: walks toward {target} with a calm, unhurried stride, his leafy cloak rustling and staff in hand
moves.back: steps back calmly, staff held upright
moves.strafe_left: steps to the left, his leafy cloak rustling
moves.turn_to: turns to face {target}, staff held upright
moves.idle: stands calmly, leaning lightly on his spiral staff

characters.look: a woman in a purple hooded robe over violet armour
characters.setting: a walled training courtyard in a crystal city with polished violet paving and glowing rune panels on the walls, three training dummies on round stands, crystal-trimmed crates and square violet pillars
characters.lighting: Soft bright purple twilight glows on the reflective pavement
characters.props: The walls become pale crystal-city walls with glowing violet rune panels, the ground is polished reflective violet paving, the three grey dummies become training dummies with silver armour plates on round crystal stands, the boxes become crystal-trimmed crates and the tall blocks become violet stone pillars.

melee_attack.name: Arcane Palm
melee_attack.text: draws her glowing right hand back and thrusts her palm into {target} in a burst of violet light
melee_attack.again: strikes {target} again with a glowing violet palm

phases.windup: steps in and draws her right hand back, her palm glowing violet
phases.impact: her glowing palm strikes {target} in a burst of arcane light
phases.recover: lowers her hand as the violet glow fades

ranged_attack.name: Arcane Bolt
ranged_attack.text: raises her right hand at {target} at shoulder height, a violet orb gathering in her palm, and fires a sparkling arcane bolt that bursts into violet light on it
ranged_attack.again: raises her glowing hand again and fires another arcane bolt at {target}

phases.windup: raises her right hand to shoulder height toward {target}, a glowing violet orb gathering in her palm
phases.release: pushes her palm forward and the orb launches as a bright violet arcane bolt
phases.travel: the bolt streaks across the courtyard trailing violet sparkles
phases.impact: it bursts against {target} in a flash of violet light and floating runes

dash.name: Blink
dash.text: blinks forward in a flash of violet light, leaving glowing runes behind her

moves.walk_to: walks toward {target} with a smooth, graceful stride, her purple robe flowing
moves.back: steps back gracefully, one hand faintly glowing
moves.strafe_left: glides to the left, her hood and robe swaying
moves.idle: stands calmly, a faint violet glow flickering around her fingers
